race.comment: ROSE AYE (6) drops from Sydney Saturday company and is clearly the one to beat. Was ridden upside down last time in town when back in the ruck. Blinkers go on first time and you can bet she will be right up on speed this time. proven enough at 1200m to take beating. Cole's 2kg claim gets her in at featherweight and will make her an arduous task to reel in. GRACEFUL ELLEN (3) kicks off her climb to the Kozzy. Is drawn to stalk them into it and will appreciate a solid tempo. Suspect she will be hitting the line hard. CHOLANTE (7) was a sharp improver here last time in her second start for the stable, winning a CL2. Gets significant weight off with the rise in grade but has more to offer and suspect she will get better the more time Pepper spends with her. BRUTAL EYES (9) has returned in good order with back-to-back placings with excuses last time with difficulty getting clear. Deserves safe keeping in the minors. HELL OF A FOX (4) returns short of her best but is a knockout hope late.
